elements.text: was: no URLs, 3 names per section → as-is
Four corners and a rail, on the sky. Every section has an address. The home shell hands off to the game HUD in the same corners.
top: rail (center) + comms (right) · middle: content · bottom: readout (left) + orb (right)
Disengage (back to port) top-right · the orb bottom-right, field down · nothing else: scanner, progress, hint and dev controls are dev builds only
rail: dots + current label · comms → one LINKS button (decided on Responsive)
Sections — one table, one name each

Rail click · arrow keys · wheel / swipe steps one section · the orb stick · a link to /#projects · back/forward. Every one sets the hash; the hash sets the section. The invisible 350vh scroller is gone. Comms (GitHub, résumé, contact) is one move from anywhere on home.

Navigation.tsx's 350vh invisible scroller and document.querySelector(".overflow-y-auto") scrolling · LABELS / orbContent.title / heading as three spellings · dev controls in production · the client-only layout with no <title> (metadata → Pages).

knowledge.text: Home: StarRail top-center (NavBar.tsx), content column (Layout.tsx), InfoBar bottom-left, Orb bottom-right. Game: scanner top-left, Disengage top-right, dev controls bottom-left (GameHUD.tsx:75), hint + progress bottom, Cori is the butterfly.
Navigation through an invisible 350vh scroller (Navigation.tsx:98), arrow keys, rail clicks, orb drag; no URLs. Names written 3 ways: NavBar LABELS ("WORK EXP"), orbContent.title, heading.
Each section has a hash address (/#work): back/forward step sections, links work. Wheel/swipe steps one section; the 350vh scroller goes.
knowledge.why: Lets a section be linked (a recruiter to Projects) and keeps the static export.

knowledge.text: A comms Plate top-right on home: GITHUB ↗ · RÉSUMÉ ↗ · CONTACT as quiet sm Buttons.
knowledge.why: Site-wide links one move away; the site had none.

knowledge.text: Launching the game hands off: the home shell fades out over DUR.scene and Disengage fades in top-right, where comms was; the orb stays, its field down. Disengage reverses it.
One SECTIONS table {id, rail, title}; rail names one word where possible (ABOUT, WORK, SKILLS, PROJECTS, OPEN SOURCE, PLAY).
Dev builds only: the scanner, progress, the controls hint and the dev controls (zoom, lines, unlock, reset). The game HUD is the orb + Disengage.
Phone: the rail shows dots + the current label only; comms collapses to one LINKS button opening a small Frame. Decided on Responsive.
The rail (nav bar) stays, top-center: it is one more projection from the orb (rings, shimmer, pulse like every surface). The orb and the rail both navigate; the rail is the plain, clickable one.
knowledge.why: User, 2026-11-22: "it's just another projection. it's good for, well, nav."

agent.brief: The always-on layer: rail + comms on top, content column, info readout bottom-left, orb bottom-right; in play the HUD Plates take the same corners. Sections are hash states.
rules: home/sections.ts: `export const SECTIONS = [{id:"about", rail:"ABOUT", title:"About Me"}, {id:"work", rail:"WORK", title:"Experience"}, {id:"skills", rail:"SKILLS", title:"Education & Skills"}, {id:"projects", rail:"PROJECTS", title:"Selected Works"}, {id:"osc", rail:"OPEN SOURCE", title:"Open Source"}, {id:"play", rail:"PLAY", title:"Initiate Simulation"}]`. NavBar LABELS, orbContent.title and SectionConfig.heading read from it (orbContent keeps date/role).

Navigation: the active section = location.hash (default about). Rail click, arrow keys, the orb stick and a wheel/swipe step (one section per gesture, ignore further input for DUR.scene) all `history.pushState(null, "", "#" + id)` and set the store; a hashchange/popstate listener sets the store from the hash. Delete the 350vh scroller (Navigation.tsx:98) and every querySelector(".overflow-y-auto").scrollTo. Calm: same, no scene easing.

Comms Plate (home/base/Comms.tsx): fixed top-4 right-4 tablet:top-6 tablet:right-6 z-40; three Button quiet sm as <a target=_blank rel="noopener noreferrer">: GITHUB ↗, RÉSUMÉ ↗, CONTACT (mailto). URLs and the address come from the user; never invent them.

Handoff: gameActive → rail, comms, panel, info readout and orb animate opacity 0 + pointer-events none over DUR.scene (calm: DUR.base fade); GameHUD Plates fade in after. Disengage (top-right, where comms sits) reverses it and restores the hash.
GameHUD: in production only Disengage (top-right) and the orb; the scanner, progress, hint and dev plate render only when process.env.NODE_ENV === "development".
Z ladder as Shape: sky 0 · content 20 · orb 30 · rail, comms, readout 40 · HUD, Cori 50.
Orb: becomes OrbStick (Responsive) — fully on screen bottom-right, the stick dials sections, ring buttons step entries; replaces the diamond drag.
